title: Changed conditions clarify a promise’s weight

captions.emotions: Feeling proportion between promises and expectations

meaning: You can discover an accusation’s mistaken foundation and consider changed circumstances, feeling the distinction between an actual promise and an enlarged expectation.
text: The Tower in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in discovering an accusation’s mistaken foundation. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports willingness to consider changed circumstances and seek a reply suited to them. Justice in emotions brings a feeling of proportion between what was promised and expected. You can recognise that a familiar condition no longer holds and hear the commitment more precisely. Change does not automatically remove promises, but helps distinguish agreement’s content from previously convenient conditions.

For example, “We will discuss it on the way home” is treated as a refusal to talk when your shared route unexpectedly changes. Conversation reveals the accusation rested on assuming no other time was possible. **Changed circumstances clarify the question without passing sentence on a promise**. You discuss what still needs an answer. This distinction can feel fair: wanting to talk was real, while the former setting proved an unreliable basis. The conditions actually available now matter.

Difficulty arises if every change becomes sufficient explanation for endless postponement. Proportion then remains a pleasing justification while the promise’s substance disappears. The constructive Wheel of Fortune helps respond to present circumstances, including an honest account of what is possible. You can consider the changed route and still hear the outstanding question; acknowledging conditions requires neither dismissing every expectation nor guaranteeing the old arrangement regardless of events.
